_readme: What enchantments, potion effects, biomes and foods are like, in a few plain words, written for Bedrock and checked against minecraft.wiki. The data says which ones exist; these say what they do. Change or add any line. An enchantment or effect missing here is left out of the book.

enchantments.aqua_affinity: It lets you mine fast underwater.
enchantments.bane_of_arthropods: It does extra damage to spiders, bees, silverfish and endermites.
enchantments.binding_curse: It's a curse: once you put it on, you can't take it off.
enchantments.breach: Mace hits get through some of the armor.
enchantments.channeling: In a thunderstorm, a trident you throw at a mob makes lightning strike it.
enchantments.density: Mace smash attacks do more damage the farther you fall.
enchantments.depth_strider: It lets you walk faster underwater.
enchantments.feather_falling: You take less damage when you fall.
enchantments.fire_aspect: It sets what you hit on fire.
enchantments.fire_protection: It protects you from fire and lava.
enchantments.flame: Your arrows set what they hit on fire.
enchantments.fortune: Some blocks drop more, like diamond ore and coal ore.
enchantments.frost_walker: It turns water into ice under your feet as you walk.
enchantments.impaling: The trident does extra damage to mobs that are in water or rain.
enchantments.infinity: You can shoot as much as you like with just one arrow.
enchantments.knockback: It knocks mobs farther back when you hit them.
enchantments.loyalty: The trident flies back to you after you throw it.
enchantments.luck_of_the_sea: You catch more treasure when fishing.
enchantments.lunge: Your spear's jab pushes you forward.
enchantments.mending: Experience orbs you pick up fix the item.
enchantments.multishot: Your crossbow shoots 3 arrows at once.
enchantments.piercing: Crossbow arrows go through mobs and hit the ones behind.
enchantments.projectile_protection: It protects you from arrows and other things shot at you.
enchantments.protection: It protects you from most kinds of damage.
enchantments.punch: Your arrows knock mobs farther back.
enchantments.respiration: You can stay underwater longer before you run out of air.
enchantments.riptide: Throwing the trident in water or rain launches you along with it.
enchantments.silk_touch: Blocks drop themselves, like glass or a grass block.
enchantments.smite: It does extra damage to undead mobs, like zombies and skeletons.
enchantments.soul_speed: You walk faster on soul sand and soul soil.
enchantments.thorns: It hurts mobs that hit you.
enchantments.unbreaking: The item lasts longer before it breaks.
enchantments.vanishing_curse: It's a curse: the item disappears when you die.
enchantments.wind_burst: After a mace smash attack, you bounce up into the air.

goesOn.equippable: armor and other things you wear
goesOn.durability: anything that wears out, like tools and armor

effects.fire_resistance: Fire and lava can't hurt you.
effects.invisibility: You turn invisible, but armor you wear still shows.
effects.blindness: You can hardly see, and you can't sprint.
effects.night_vision: You can see in the dark.
effects.poison: Hurts you over time, but it can't take your last heart.
effects.wither: Hurts you over time and turns your hearts black. It can kill you.
effects.absorption: Gives you golden hearts that soak up damage.
effects.levitation: You float up into the air.
effects.slow_falling: You fall slowly and take no fall damage.
effects.conduit_power: Underwater you can breathe, see clearly and mine faster.
effects.bad_omen: Walk into a village with it and a raid starts.
effects.hero_of_the_village: Villagers give you lower prices and gifts.
effects.darkness: Your screen goes dark and pulses. The Warden gives you this.
effects.trial_omen: Trial spawners near you turn ominous: harder mobs and better loot.
effects.raid_omen: A raid is about to start in the village.
effects.wind_charged: When you die, you let out a big burst of wind.
effects.weaving: When you die, you leave cobwebs behind.
effects.oozing: When you die, two slimes appear.
effects.infested: Getting hurt can make silverfish come out of you.

foods.pufferfish: It poisons you and makes you sick.
foods.chicken: Raw chicken can make you hungry. Cook it first.
foods.chorus_fruit: It teleports you a short way.
foods.golden_apple: It heals you and gives you extra golden hearts.
foods.enchanted_golden_apple: It heals you, gives you golden hearts, and protects you from fire and damage for a while.
foods.suspicious_stew: It gives you a surprise effect.
foods.golden_carrot: It keeps you full the longest of any food.

best-food.title: The best food
best-food.say: Steak and cooked porkchops are the best everyday food: each fills 4 drumsticks and keeps you full a long time. Golden carrots keep you full even longer.
